property_summary: After any successful fallback call (which requires msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime), the reference contract sets pastBlockTime to strictly greater than the block.timestamp at completion (block.timestamp + 1), while the mutant sets it to block.timestamp and can therefore make pastBlockTime == block.timestamp for some inputs.
change_summary: Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp (instead of block.timestamp + 1), changing the stored value observable after a successful fallback call.
